project_metadata.name: Jomir Dalal AI
project_metadata.tagline: জমির আসল সত্য জানতে, আপনার বিশ্বস্ত ডিজিটাল সহকারী

project_overview.concept_summary: An AI-powered Land Copilot and Audit Engine tailored for Bangladesh land administration. It simplifies traditional Bangla Khatian fractional math (Ana, Gonda, Kara, Kranti), performs inheritance (Farai'd) co-sharer risk audits, and generates an instant 'Land Truth Scorecard' to prevent land fraud before transactions.
project_overview.value_proposition: Replaces opaque middleman processes with an objective, transparent, and accessible AI assistant that exposes mathematical share errors and hidden co-sharer exclusions in Bangla land records.

core_features.name: Bangla Khatian OCR & Structured Extraction
core_features.description: Extracts raw text from scanned Bangla Khatian documents (CS, SA, RS, BS) using Gemini 1.5 Flash multimodal vision API and formats output into structured JSON.
inputs: Scanned Bangla Khatian image or PDF

core_features.name: Ana-Gonda Fractional Share Math Engine
core_features.description: Converts traditional Bangladeshi land measurement units into exact decimals and ownership percentages.

conversion_formula.subdivisions: 1 Ana = 20 Gonda | 1 Gonda = 4 Kara | 1 Kara = 3 Kranti | 1 Kranti = 20 Til

core_features.name: Farai'd Inheritance & Co-Sharer Audit Engine
core_features.description: Calculates legal heir shares based on Islamic/Hindu inheritance rules and cross-checks against current seller share to detect un-mutated or illegally excluded co-sharer portions.
inputs: Family Tree / Heirs Breakdown (Spouse, Sons, Daughters)

core_features.name: Land Truth Scorecard (1-Page Diagnostic)
core_features.description: Generates a clear visual diagnostic report with color-coded risk indicators for citizens, banks, and sub-registry offices.

status_levels.GREEN: Clear Title: Mathematical share matches and all legal heirs/co-sharers are accounted for.
status_levels.YELLOW: Minor Warning: Minor fractional rounding discrepancy or pending mutation.
status_levels.RED: High Risk: Excluded legal heirs, un-mutated ancestral share, or over-allocation risk.

ai_services.multimodal_ocr: Google AI Studio API (Gemini 1.5 Flash) with Structured JSON Output mode

technical_architecture.database: SQLite / PostgreSQL (for dummy Khatians and synthetic family trees)

dummy_dataset_schema.rulebook_compliance: Zero scraping of live government portals, zero real NIDs or personal data. Uses synthetic benchmark records.

prompts_for_ai_coding_assistants.system_prompt: You are building 'Jomir Dalal AI', an AI-powered land record audit tool for Bangladesh under LandTech 2026. Use Python FastAPI for the backend, Gemini 1.5 Flash API for Bangla Khatian OCR extraction into structured JSON, implement Ana-Gonda math conversion algorithms (16 Ana = 100%), Farai'd inheritance rules, and generate a 1-page Land Truth Scorecard output with Green/Yellow/Red risk ratings.
